text:
And take great care of the Zeppelins

Of Zeppelins of every kind

Those of the Boches are not bad

The French ones are much fuller

And take great care of the Zeppelins

Every French officer carries one

translation.title: And Take Great Care of the Zeppelins

Translated directly from the supplied Spanish text; no separate editorial review was performed.
